# Member

## Summary
A club member IS a loyalty account — the club's only specialization is its
own ladder (`MemberTierField`: Bronze ×1, Silver ×1.5, Gold ×2, Legend ×3).
Member number, holder, ledger-maintained balances and membership status are
consumed unchanged from the Loyalty Account block.

## Ladder contract
Legend is invitation-only: no upgrade prompt ever offers it. Multipliers
are the published earning rates the attendance arithmetic quotes.

## Usage
```ts
import { Member, MemberTierField } from './club-membership/member';
```
The linked example is a Gold member with a live ledger.
